Passed military-grade protection testing at a height of 2.44 meters and obtained MIL-STD-810H certification, so your phone always stays secure.
The four corners use an arched design that creates space around the phone like built-in air cushions. On impact they deform to absorb the shock, so accidental drops land softly.
Finely woven aramid fiber gives the case a silky, luxurious texture you can feel. It is not just light and strong, it is a pleasure to hold, every single time.
A recreation of “Sunset Moment”, the first hit of the Weaving+ series, weaving the immersive blue hours from sunset to moonrise into the case.
